name: Spotify
layout_summary: Top bar: Home icon and centered 'What do you want to play?' search bar. Left sidebar: Your Library (playlists, artists, albums). Center pane: browse/search results or active playlist tracklist. Bottom bar: current track info on left, playback controls (Shuffle, Previous, Play/Pause, Next, Repeat) in center, volume slider at bottom-right.
avoid_traps: Do NOT click the track title at bottom-left when trying to pause — press 'space' or click the center Play/Pause circle button.
After searching with ctrl+k or ctrl+l, press enter or click the green Play button on hover over the top result to actually start playing.

play_pause.visual_fallback: smart_click('Play or Pause circle button at bottom center')
play_pause.verify: Playback toggles between playing and paused

next_track.visual_fallback: smart_click('Next track skip forward icon at bottom center')

prev_track.visual_fallback: smart_click('Previous track skip back icon at bottom center')
prev_track.verify: Restarts current song or returns to the previous song

search.visual_fallback: smart_type('What do you want to play?', query, submit=true)
search.verify: Search results for songs, artists, and playlists load in main pane

toggle_shuffle.visual_fallback: smart_click('Shuffle crossed arrows icon at bottom center')

toggle_repeat.visual_fallback: smart_click('Repeat loop arrows icon at bottom center')
toggle_repeat.verify: Repeat mode cycles (Off / Repeat All / Repeat One)
